message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data from local directories and YAML config files only; no remote data fetching with integrity checks or authentication is present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models via `load_model(network, optimizer, scheduler, recorder, cfg.model_dir, resume=cfg.resume)` in train.py with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before loading weights.
No detected label distribution validation: The code only counts class names to set num_classes but never checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before passing it to the model; only task-type checks (classify vs semantic_segm) are done for configuration purposes.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference/test path returns a loss value without any NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold checks on model outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision pipeline (image classification/semantic segmentation), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
